title: Current FreeCAD DXF route and independent DXF/DWG peer boundaries
mode: deeper/broader primary-source research and plan refinement
scope: Recheck current FreeCAD DWG converter and DXF importer routes
Separate wrapper success, converter output validity, importer selection, and semantic dispositions
Reassess ezdxf direct DXF, transfer, and ACIS inspection boundaries
Reconfirm LibreDWG version/direction limits relevant to comparative evidence

sources.observation: The adapter contains LibreDWG, ODA, and QCAD conversion paths. Its subprocess helpers wait for completion but do not inspect process return status. DWG-to-DXF accepts a produced path based on existence; the DWG export helper returns the requested path after converter completion without validating that output.
Documents automatic/selected DWG converters and separate legacy Python versus C++ DXF importer/exporter preferences with different feature sets.

Lists distinct C++ and legacy Python DXF importer coverage; notes 3DFACE support in the legacy importer, omissions such as text/dimensions/attributes inside blocks in the C++ route, and that stock FreeCAD cannot read DXF ACIS/SAT solids. Documentation claims are not a runtime qualification.

sources.project: ezdxf current scope, XREF documentation, and launcher documentation
sources.observation: ezdxf declares ASCII/Binary DXF read/write across named versions and third-party content retention. Its XREF transfer documentation says unsupported entities and many HEADER/OBJECTS features are not supported and may be ignored. The ACIS browser exposes raw SAT/SAB inspection/export, not a semantic B-rep validator.

sources.project: LibreDWG current manual and repository scope
sources.observation: The manual documents broad DWG read coverage with some advanced R2010+ objects skipped, R2007 write limitations, and R2010-R2018 writes that still fail CRC/audit checks in external CAD applications. These are project-reported limitations, not a run of a pinned artifact in this workspace.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Strengthened the existing composed FreeCAD gate to bind the converter and DXF importer independently, inspect converter exit status/output/version rather than trusting wrapper return paths, and score source-object dispositions. Clarified ezdxf transfer/ACIS limits and LibreDWG high-version writer caveats without creating per-slice prerequisites.
planImpact.nextImplementation: Continue the existing local-ready implementation queue and fast per-slice validation; apply the route tuple only at the already-scheduled composed consumer checkpoint.

method.limitations: All web sources are mutable main-branch source or documentation snapshots. No exact FreeCAD build, converter artifact, ezdxf release, or LibreDWG binary was installed or executed; no operational result or semantic support claim follows from this research.
